explanation: Wild birds eat raw rice and other grains in fields without harm. The story spread with advice against throwing rice at weddings, but no evidence ever supported it.

claims.text: Uncooked rice does not swell in birds' stomachs enough to harm them or make them burst.
Many wild birds eat uncooked rice and other grains in fields without harm.
The rice myth spread along with advice against throwing rice at weddings.
No scientific evidence supports the claim that uncooked rice makes birds burst.
